<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    fr=None; bl=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']>=20: fr=(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][2][0])
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and n['pixels']>=30 and n['boundary'][0][0]>20:
            bl.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][2][0]))
    return fr, sorted(bl)
print("before", state())
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':36}])  # white swatch
print("after white swatch", state())
print("res", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
